free.title: Free public proxies
free.description: SoftGlaze downloads the public lists that free-proxy projects publish, tests every proxy, and keeps only the ones that work, on this page and apart from your paid proxies.

warn.strangers: Free proxies are run by unknown people. Do not use them to sign in to accounts, enter passwords or pay: the owner of a proxy can see traffic that is not encrypted.
warn.quality: They are slow, often stop working within hours, and many are on blocklists, so expect more CAPTCHAs than with a paid proxy. For real account work, use a proxy provider.
warn.legal: Only use them where that is allowed. Quick generate never picks free proxies unless you choose "Free proxies" as its proxy source.

free.checks: Each proxy is tested live, and HTTP proxies that pass your real IP on to websites are rejected.

copyForExtension.title: Copy for SoftGlaze Proxy
copyForExtension.description: Copies the selected proxies as lines the SoftGlaze Proxy browser extension reads in its Bulk import box. Each line says its type (http, https, socks5 or socks4), so a SOCKS5 proxy is never read as HTTP.
copyForExtension.skipped: Left out: {{count}} (a type, address or port the extension does not read).
copyForExtension.credsNoRole: Your role cannot see proxy usernames and passwords. Ask an owner or admin.
copyForExtension.credsNone: None of the selected proxies has a username or password.
copyForExtension.socks5Note: SOCKS5 proxies with a login: {{count}}. Chrome and Edge cannot sign in to SOCKS5 proxies, so the extension will not take those lines there. Firefox can use them.
copyForExtension.socks4Note: SOCKS4 proxies with a login: {{count}}. They are copied without it, because SOCKS4 has no password and the extension does not take one.
copyForExtension.clipboardWarning: Other programs on this computer can read the clipboard. The app clears it after 2 minutes if it still holds this list.
copyForExtension.copied: Copied {{count}} proxies without usernames or passwords. In the extension, open Proxies, choose Bulk import and paste.
copyForExtension.copiedWithCredentials: Copied {{count}} proxies with their usernames and passwords. In the extension, open Proxies, choose Bulk import and paste.
copyForExtension.loadError: Could not read the selected proxies.
